a35d6e9b: ; Routine to queue an entry in TaskMan to run a process at a later time.
 .;
 .;This routine sets up the variables needed to queue a task and calls
 .;%ZTLOAD to actually queue the task in the TaskMan.
 .;
 .;If the task is successfully queued the routine will write a success
 .;message, otherwise it will write a cancel message.
09eabd43: ; Store the time the task was queued.

26f0a94e: ; If $IO is not defined and ION is null, initialize ZTIO to null.
 .;ZTIO is used by %ZTLOAD to pass information for device handling.

7aa97e54: ; If ZTDESC (TaskMan description) is not defined, set it to the value
 .;of DGPGM (if defined), PGM (if defined), or 'IRT UNKNOWN OPTION'.

db18968e: ; If ZTRTN (TaskMan routine) is not defined, set it to the entry
 .;point 'DQ^DGJUTQ'. This is the routine and label that will be
 .;executed when the task runs.

5aebcd11: ; Save any variables that need to be restored when the task runs.
 .;DGZTSAVE is set to DGVAR (if defined) or VAR (if defined) or '*'.

f45716b1: ; If DGPGM is defined but not included in ZTSAVE, add it to
 .;ZTSAVE so it will be restored when the task runs.

90cd8c4c: ; Call %ZTLOAD to actually queue the task. Write a success or
 .;cancel message based on whether ZTSK (TaskMan task number) is
 .;defined. Set X='^' if task was cancelled, otherwise set X=''.
 .;If task was queued, go to CLOSE label, else go to END label.
bd268caf: If the user quits the routine, do not execute any other code.
9bc2f92b: If the output is being queued, go to the QUE label to queue the report, otherwise close the device.
ac410a16: Use the selected device.
a0d3bc55: Save specified variables in the ZTSAVE array for tasked jobs. Handle global references in variable names.
07e2a048: ;Process DgzTSave, if # found in string, replace with ()
55f00dfb: ;Loop through the string and replace all # with ()
85a7248c: ;Quit if task is closed
3fa501a9: ;If the task is not queued, clear device
ea8a0bbc: ;Kill all task related variables
d72f5157: Quit if called from top level.
3468ebe2: Execute entry point task code, either DGPGM, PGM, or CLOSE.
947574fb: Clean up task variables and close device.
261a0bd0: Exit the routine.
3e99cf5c: Exit the routine.
